**Date:** [November or December?1894]  
**Manuscript:** MS fragment West Devon Area Record Office Ac 1092/37
:::

[To [Mary Yonge](people/person_1626.qmd)]

after a bad passage.   [Frances](people/person_1604.qmd) and [Helen](people/person_1613.qmd) both spend Christmas at the Vicarage, but one must go back when [Maurice](people/person_1630.qmd)’s short holiday is over –

[Henry](people/person_184.qmd)’s old [uncle](people/person_2144.qmd), a Canon of Chichester has left him £1000[^1]

---

[^1]: The death of the Rev. Francis Alfred Bowles, Rector of Singleton, Prebendary of Chichester, was reported in the *Morning Post* (30 October 1894).  His nephew the Rev. Henry Bowles, vicar of Otterbourne, was married to CMY's niece Alethea, who was entertaining her mother and sister for Christmas.
